ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate WA phone: backend returns 409 with body {detail: "phone 'xxx' already exists"}, but the client-side handler checks `/409/.test(err.message)` which never matches because api.js `unwrap()` OVERWRITES the initial `HTTP 409` message with the backend `detail` string. Result: user sees generic 'Gagal simpan pelanggan — phone "xxx" already exists' instead of the intended INFO toast 'Nomor WA sudah terdaftar — data lama dipakai'. Verified by attempting a duplicate save with the same phone → wrong toast copy shown, duplicate local hydration branch skipped.

action_items: Fix POSScreen.jsx duplicate-phone 409 detection: either (a) change condition to `err.message.includes('already exists')` OR (b) have api.js `unwrap()` attach the status code to the thrown Error (e.g., `err.status = res.status`) and switch the check to `err.status === 409`. Approach (b) is cleaner and future-proof for other 409 endpoints (customers, prices, etc.).
critical_code_review_comments: api.js `unwrap()` throws a plain Error whose message is the backend `detail` string when JSON is returned — this deletes the HTTP status code information from the caller. Recommend attaching `err.status = res.status` and `err.body = j` so downstream code can branch on status instead of regex-parsing message text. Currently only POSScreen relies on 409 detection; adding this now prevents future duplicate-message bugs.

POSScreen.jsx resetAll() is complete and idempotent — all 20 state slots reset in one call. Nice work extending it to cover speedTier, evidencePhotos, paymentProof, customerSearchOpen, and the register modal drafts.

OverdueWidget.jsx correctly filters by payment_status=Nanti — but note there is NO server-side sorting by days overdue; the widget shows the first 10 from the newest-first order listing which may not surface the most-overdue debts. Consider `?sort=created_at:asc` support on /api/orders or sorting client-side by daysOverdue desc before slicing.

StaffPerformance.jsx computePerformance credits every event on an order to a staff once (uses Set on order_id) — good. Actor regex `/(?:kasir|kurir|produksi|staff|packing|operator)-(.+)$/` correctly handles the `getActorTag()` prefix format.

Production Scanner and Admin Piutang show customer names 'Budi Santoso' / 'Dedi Supardi' — these are BACKEND SEED customers in /app/backend/routes/seed.py lines 48-53 (not hardcoded frontend mocks). This is expected behavior — the review scope requires empty-state when DB has zero rows, and the frontend correctly renders whatever is in the DB. If the user wants these seed names removed, backend/routes/seed.py CUSTOMER_ROWS should be updated. Not a bug per this iteration's scope.

rca of the issue: 409 duplicate WA toast: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js `unwrap()` first sets `detail = 'HTTP 409'` but then if the JSON body has a `.detail` field it OVERWRITES with the backend text (e.g. "phone '087721668417' already exists"). The thrown Error.message therefore no longer contains '409'. The check `if (/409/.test(err.message))` in POSScreen.jsx line 1195 never matches, so the code falls through to the generic error toast and never hydrates the local regular customers list with the duplicate row. Fix: attach err.status = res.status inside unwrap() and switch the check to `err.status === 409`.
